source: a 3d dti but it's called fashion week and you wake up on a bed walk into your closet and pick an outfit a y2k, cute core, or emo or big puffy dresses and you have a 5 minute time limit and when the time is up you go on the runway and people around the world will vote you stars

answers.ask: No theme was stated - should the bedroom and runway read as glossy modern fashion-show, or bright stylized toon?
answers.answer: Use a bright stylized toon look that fits the cute Fashion Week dress-up vibe.

answers.ask: Is the bedroom and closet one shared dressing area everyone uses, or a private copy per player?
answers.answer: Give each player a private bedroom and closet so everyone can pick their outfit without crowding.

scene_prompt: Create a bright stylized-toon 3D fashion dress-up map with private bedroom-and-closet dressing suites for each player. Each suite begins at a bed and opens into a personal closet area displaying outfit options including Y2K, cute-core, emo, and large puffy dresses. Connect the dressing area to a glossy fashion-show runway, with a clear catwalk and viewing space arranged around it for spectators.
